item.title: Bhakti is not just a choice of the head – it is also the calling of the heart
item.description: By Chaitanya Charan Das Suppose we are driving to some destination and come to a fork. If we are unsure about which way to go, we will move slowly or not move at all. But even if we are sure, that conviction alone will not take us ahead – we need to drive ahead. A similar dynamic applies to our spiritual practice.
